subject.title: fix(feishu): retry once on token-invalid errors 99991663/99991664 with cache invalidation (fixes #97287)

question: Should invalid-token recovery invalidate only the affected Feishu account/appId, or is clearing every registered SDK and CardKit token cache an intentional supported policy?
rationale: Both approaches can recover the reported send failure, but the current global registry changes multi-account auth behavior and the two open PRs encode different owner boundaries; repository evidence cannot determine that product and operational tradeoff safely.

options.title: Scope invalidation per account
options.body: Pass the affected account/appId through the retry hook and clear only its SDK and CardKit entries, avoiding unrelated account refreshes.

options.title: Accept global invalidation
options.body: Keep the process-wide registry only with explicit Feishu-owner approval and live or concurrency proof that unrelated accounts remain reliable.

options.title: Consolidate implementations
options.body: Pause this branch and select a revised canonical implementation across this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97431 before further merge work.

recommendation.title: Scope invalidation per account
recommendation.body: Pass the affected account/appId through the retry hook and clear only its SDK and CardKit entries, avoiding unrelated account refreshes.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository guidance identifies sliverp as the Feishu channel owner, making them the strongest available owner for the cache-scope and canonical-branch decision.
